maps.title: Step 1a Role Selection
maps.role: User selects or searches for a role before entering posting evidence.
maps.handoff: Feeds a role title/query into Step 2.

implementationCommit.role: Published Step 1a map and mobile layout source on main.

deploymentStatus.notes: The Step 2 feature-map branch does not change Step 1a deployment state.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: Step 1a screenshots and browser evidence remain in its published map; this index does not add a new physical device pass.

maps.title: Step 2 Posting Evidence Picker
maps.role: User compares live source postings and selects one evidence-bearing job ad.
maps.handoff: Feeds the selected posting payload into Step 3.

implementationCommit.role: Current Step 2 implementation inspected as source evidence.

deploymentStatus.notes: GitHub commit statuses report successful deployment processing for the merge commit. This is deployment status, not physical-runtime verification.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: The Step 2 map includes automated Chromium evidence, not physical-phone production verification.

maps.title: Step 3 Work Universe
maps.role: Planned map for Work Universe analysis after a selected posting or role run.
maps.handoff: Receives the selected Step 2 posting payload or Step 1a role query.

implementationCommit.role: Current known Step 3 source baseline at time of Step 2 map provenance update.

deploymentStatus.notes: This index records that Step 3 is planned; it does not verify Step 3 deployment.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: Physical Step 3 runtime evidence must be attached to MAP-V3-STEP3-001 when that map is created.

connections.contract: Step 1a provides the role title/query; Step 2 must not convert SSOC suggestion state into a source-posting prefilter.
Step 2 selected-posting Analyse passes the selected job object, including source description/responsibilities, to the Step 3 analysis path.

contracts.statement: Every map entry separates implementation commit, merge commit, deployment status and physical-runtime verification.
Feature-map work must preserve v3/ and Railway configuration unless explicitly requested otherwise.
